overall_summary: Analysis of the 14 videos reveals a clear outperformance of relationship and marital dynamic themes (Husband-Wife, Shaadi ke baad pyaar) reaching up to 1.7k+ views, significantly outperforming generic sad shayari or standalone family member clips.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' (1,766 views) and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' (1,671 views) achieved the highest traction on the channel.
winning_patterns.action: Focus more core content on modern relationship realities and emotional distance after marriage.

weak_patterns.evidence: Video titled 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' generated only 12 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid abstract, overly poetic, or bitter wording; stick to grounded, everyday relationship observations.

next_video.concept: A couple sitting in the same room scrolling phones in total silence, realizing they know everything about their phones, but nothing about each other's day anymore.
next_video.opening_direction: Start with the sound of notification tones and a silent living room.
next_video.twist_direction: The realization that physical closeness means nothing when the emotional distance is this wide.
next_video.reason: Aligns with the top-performing husband-wife relationship themes that drove the highest engagement historically.

experiment: Testing if emotional distance in modern routines drives higher engagement than direct marital conflict questions.
